# IT System Review and Optimization Plan

This plan details critical tasks for enhancing our IT infrastructure's security and performance.

*   Review encryption standards based on audit findings.
*   Optimize firewall settings based on audit recommendations.
*   Update firewall settings to align with standard updates.
*   Investigate database migration options as part of a standard update.
*   Optimize API latency to improve system performance, following standard update guidelines.
